effective_from.description: The first day it applies; a person's rate of a day is the latest starting on or before it. A rate never changes: enter the new one from its day.

hourly_rate.description: The cost of an hour in the base currency: payroll cost divided by standard hours, or an agreed rate; a plain decimal, at most 6 decimals.

role.description: The role the person is grouped under for role-average rates (at least three people share a role); required with a person.

user_id.description: The person, an active member; left out, the organisation's standard rate (the Owner's fallback for viewers who may not see a person's own).
